data_fields.name: blow_energy_table
data_fields.donor_constant: 12x12 table, 100 down to 15 (hundredths of a turn per blow)

data_fields.name: bonus_blow_step
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 hundredths per bonus blow, added after the cap

data_fields.name: always_hit_and_miss
data_fields.donor_constant: always hit 12 percent, always miss 5 percent; to-hit floor 9

best_idea: A derived attack rate from a stat band and the weapon weight, divided by a per-class multiplier and capped per class, so a light weapon with good stats swings faster than a heavy one.
decision_why: Keep the stat-band and weight idea, but as a swing interval in src/fight priced in stamina, with a small curve in class catalogue data instead of the 12x12 table; the donor is turn-based and has no stamina.
acceptance: Server test: a warrior with STR 18/10 and DEX 18/50 gets 3.03 blows per turn (donor units) with a 1.2 lb dagger and 2.38 with a 4.0 lb weapon; a too-heavy weapon gives one swing with a to-hit penalty of 2 per pound over hold; the rate never exceeds the class max.
